Our story

Crafted with care,
served with love

Sip'd & Co is a mobile drink cart bringing beautifully crafted matcha, coffee, and mocktails to your most special moments. We set up, pour with care, and make sure every single guest feels taken care of.

From intimate mehndis and Eid galas to university formals and weddings, our cart becomes the most-photographed spot at every event.

What we offer

The sip'd. experience

Matcha · Coffee · Chai · Mocktails

01

Matcha Cart

Made with organic ceremonial-grade matcha and natural sweeteners. Just pure, made-with-love matcha the way it should be.

  • Classic
  • Strawberry
  • Mango
  • Banana Bread
  • Cookie Butter
  • Blueberry
  • + More
02

Coffee Cart

Specialty espresso-based drinks, crafted with quality beans and steamed milk (dairy or alt-milk options). Made fresh at your event with the same care as our matcha.

  • Iced Spanish Latte
  • Iced Vanilla Latte
  • Iced Caramel Macchiato
  • + More
03

Chai Bar

Warm, spiced, and made from scratch — our chai is simmered with real spices and finished creamy or iced, depending on the vibe of your event.

  • Masala Chai
  • Karak Chai
  • Chai Latte
  • + More
04

Mocktail Cart

Vibrant mocktails made fresh at your event. Beautiful layered colours, bold flavours — a drink your guests will photograph before they sip.

  • Lychee Rose
  • Blue Raspberry Lemonade
  • Mango Spritz
  • Strawberry Lemonade
  • + More

Custom Menus

Each package includes a custom menu for your event — themed names, colour palette, and flavours built around your vision. Your event, our cart.

What's included

What Each Package Offers

The Cart & Setup

Our fully styled mobile cart arrives ready to go — no bare tables, no makeshift setup. Just a beautiful station that fits right into your event's look.

Your Drink Menu

A custom-built menu from our matcha, coffee, and mocktail offerings — themed names, colours, and flavours designed around your event.

On-Site Team

Our team handles every pour from start to finish — friendly, attentive, and dressed to match your event, so you can focus on your guests.

Cups, Garnishes & Details

Branded or custom cup stickers, garnishes, and presentation touches that make every drink photo-ready — because the details matter.
